title: Vanilla Style Gems for Spectrum/Pastel
description: Reverts texture changes for Spectrum and Pastel's modded gems so they match the vanilla amethyst style.
body:
Requires either [Spectrum](https://modrinth.com/mod/spectrum) or [Pastel](https://modrinth.com/mod/pastel-mod).

Modern versions of Spectrum and Pastel have changed the textures of their gems and gemstones to use a unique artstyle, and include an optional resource pack that changes vanilla amethyst to match that style.

This pack does the opposite, for those who prefer the vanilla style: it changes the modded gems and geodes back to their older textures so that they match vanilla amethyst.

![Demonstration of the gem textures](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d15b67cb007a48057ff3f576103a515265bd26e9.png)
